A root canal is a highly effective treatment that helps save a severely damaged or infected tooth while relieving pain and preventing further dental complications. With modern dental techniques, root canal treatment is more comfortable than ever and can often be completed in just one or two visits.

Recovery is typically quick, with most patients returning to their normal routine within a day. Mild discomfort after the procedure is common and usually subsides within a few days. For Invisalign treatment to be effective, most dentists recommend wearing your aligners for 20 to 22 hours per day. Regular dental checkups can help ensure your Invisalign journey stays on track and delivers the best possible smile.

A CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scan provides a detailed 3D view of your teeth, jawbone, nerves, and surrounding oral structures, helping dentists diagnose and plan treatments with greater accuracy. At Bombay Dental Specialities, we use advanced CBCT technology to support procedures such as dental implants, root canal therapy, wisdom tooth extractions, orthodontics, and TMJ evaluations.

Malocclusion, or a misaligned bite, is a common dental condition that affects how the upper and lower teeth fit together. It can lead to difficulties with chewing, speech issues, jaw discomfort, and uneven tooth wear. Common types include overbite, underbite, crossbite, and open bite. Understanding the causes and symptoms is the first step toward maintaining better oral health.

At Bombay Dental Specialities, we provide comprehensive diagnosis and personalized treatment options for malocclusion. Depending on the severity, treatment may include braces, clear aligners, retainers, or other orthodontic solutions. Our experienced dental team helps patients achieve improved function, comfort, and a healthier, more confident smile.

What Braces Actually Move

A lot of people think orthodontic treatment is purely cosmetic. Straighten the front teeth, improve the smile, done. But the teeth being moved are connected to bone and tissue, and the position they land in affects how your jaw closes, how pressure is distributed when you chew and whether certain teeth wear faster than they should over time.

At a Dental Clinic in Ghatkopar like Dr. Jain Dental Care, orthodontic treatment is assessed alongside bite function, not just appearance. So the end position your teeth reach is one that works for your jaw, not just one that looks even in a photo.

Dr. Nikhil Jain handles orthodontics in-house at the Ghatkopar clinic. If you've been thinking about braces or aligners and want to understand what the treatment actually involves, it's worth coming in for a consultation.

What happens to an untreated cavity

A small cavity doesn't stay small. Most people notice a tiny dark spot or occasional sensitivity and assume it can wait. By the time there's real pain, the decay has usually moved past the enamel and into the dentine layer underneath, which means a simple filling is no longer enough.

Dentine is softer and more porous than enamel, so decay travels faster once it gets there. For anyone looking for a dentist in Ghatkopar, this is worth knowing before putting off an appointment. What starts as a fifteen-minute filling visit can turn into a root canal conversation within a few months if the decay reaches the pulp.

Dr. Jain Dental Care is in Ghatkopar, and Dr. Nikhil Jain sees these cases regularly. If you've spotted something and been telling yourself it'll be fine, it's worth getting it checked sooner rather than later.

When a missing tooth changes more

Most people who lose a tooth focus on the gap in the smile. That's the visible part. But what's happening underneath the gum line, in the jawbone, is the part that actually affects long-term health and what treatment options stay open later.

Bone in the jaw needs the pressure from a tooth root to stay dense. Without it, that area starts to shrink over time. A Dental Implant in Ghatkopar addresses this because the titanium post sits in the bone itself, not just on top of the gum. So the bone gets the stimulation it needs, and the neighbouring teeth don't start drifting into the space.

Dr. Jain Dental Care is in Ghatkopar, and Dr. Nikhil Jain handles implant consultations in-house. If you've had a missing tooth for a while and haven't looked into it yet, it's worth asking about what the bone looks like now.

Root Canal in Ghatkopar: What Changes

Most people assume a root canal is just about stopping pain. The pain part is true. But what actually happens during the procedure is less dramatic than the reputation suggests, and understanding it tends to remove a lot of the worry before the appointment.

The nerve tissue inside the tooth canal is cleaned out and shaped, then sealed with a material called gutta-percha. For a Root Canal in Ghatkopar, Dr. Nikhil Jain at Dr. Jain Dental Care handles this in-house, so there's no referral to a separate specialist. The tooth stays numb throughout (local anaesthesia works very reliably here), and most of the discomfort people expect simply doesn't show up.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar. If a tooth has been giving you trouble and you've been putting off getting it checked, it's worth coming in for a proper look before the situation gets harder to treat.

What sensitivity is actually telling you

Sharp pain when you sip something cold or bite into something sweet tends to get written off as 'sensitive teeth.' Most people grab a sensitivity toothpaste and move on. But that twinge is your tooth signalling something, and the signal changes depending on what's actually causing it.

Sensitivity from enamel thinning feels different from sensitivity caused by a cracked tooth or an exposed root. At a Dental Clinic in Ghatkopar like Dr. Jain Dental Care, figuring out which one it is changes the treatment entirely. A crack that causes cold sensitivity won't respond to a fluoride application. It needs a different plan.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar, just off the main stretch of the area. If that sensitivity has been sitting around for a few weeks, it's worth having Dr. Nikhil Jain take a look before it becomes something bigger.

Dentist in Ghatkopar: Scaling Facts

Bleeding gums when you brush is something most people dismiss. They figure they pressed too hard, or the bristles are stiff. But gums that bleed regularly aren't reacting to pressure — they're reacting to buildup that's been sitting along the gum line long enough to irritate the tissue underneath.

A scaling session with a dentist in Ghatkopar like Dr. Nikhil Jain at Dr. Jain Dental Care removes that hardened tartar (calculus, once it mineralises, can't come off with a toothbrush alone) before the inflammation has a chance to travel deeper into the bone. Most people feel the difference in gum firmness within a week of the cleaning.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar. If your gums have been bleeding on and off for a while, it's worth having them looked at properly before it becomes a bigger conversation.

What teeth whitening actually changes

A lot of people think teeth whitening only affects the surface colour, like a coat of paint over whatever's underneath. So if there's an old filling or a crown at the front, they assume everything will brighten together. It won't.

At a Dental Clinic in Ghatkopar like Dr. Jain Dental Care, a whitening consultation checks exactly this before anything starts. Whitening agents work on natural enamel (they don't lift staining from ceramic or composite restorations), which means a front crown stays its original shade while the teeth around it brighten. Knowing that upfront changes the treatment plan entirely.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar, and Dr. Nikhil Jain handles cosmetic consultations in-house. If you've been thinking about whitening and have any crowns or fillings in visible spots, it's worth asking about the full picture first.

Spacing between teeth matters

Crowded or gapped teeth aren't just about how a smile looks. The spaces between teeth directly affect how easy they are to clean, and whether plaque builds up in spots a toothbrush simply can't reach.

Orthodontic treatment at a Dentist in Ghatkopar like Dr. Jain Dental Care addresses this at the root level. When teeth are properly aligned, floss actually reaches the gum line cleanly (crowded teeth tend to shred floss or stop it from going all the way down), which means less inflammation and fewer cavities over time.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar, and Dr. Nikhil Jain does orthodontic consultations in-house. So if you've been putting off looking into alignment because you thought it was only cosmetic, it's worth coming in for a proper look.

What happens to bone after tooth loss

Most people focus on the gap a missing tooth leaves in their smile. What doesn't get talked about is what's happening in the jawbone underneath, quietly, from the very first month.

Bone needs stimulation to stay dense. When a tooth root is gone, the bone in that spot stops receiving that load and begins to thin out. A Dental Implant in Ghatkopar addresses this directly because the titanium post acts as a root substitute (it sits inside the bone, not just above the gum). That pressure during chewing is what keeps resorption from progressing further.

Dr. Jain Dental Care is in Ghatkopar and Dr. Nikhil Jain handles implant consultations in-house. If you've had a missing tooth for some time and want to understand what the bone situation looks like now, it's worth coming in for a proper assessment.

Root Canal Success Starts Here

Most people walk away from a root canal thinking the job is done once the canals are cleaned. It isn't. The tooth is still vulnerable until it gets a proper final restoration, and what happens in that window matters more than people realise.

After a root canal in Ghatkopar, Dr. Jain Dental Care plans the restoration as part of the same treatment conversation, not an afterthought. A back tooth that's had its pulp removed becomes brittle over time (the blood supply to that tooth is gone), so a crown placed soon after is what gives it back its load-bearing strength. Skipping that step is usually what causes treated teeth to crack or fracture later.

The clinic is in Ghatkopar, near the heart of the area. If you've had a root canal elsewhere and the tooth still doesn't have a proper crown on it, it's worth asking Dr. Jain about it before something goes wrong.
